Added
^^^^^

* Added backend-neutral collision groups with whole-path regular-expression selectors and per-group
  deny-list or allow-list relationships, realized by the active physics manager during cloning.

Changed
^^^^^^^

* Changed replicated-environment isolation to a default rule generated by the cloner and stored in
  :class:`~isaaclab.cloner.ClonePlan`. Direct workflows no longer need a separate filtering call;
  uncommon cross-environment contact is configured with ``CloneCfg.isolate_environments=False``.
* Changed :func:`isaaclab.cloner.make_clone_plan`, :class:`isaaclab.cloner.ReplicateSession`, and
  :func:`isaaclab.cloner.clone_plan_from_env_0` to accept one required ``CloneCfg`` instead of
  separate strategy, template, replication, and isolation arguments. Changed
  :func:`isaaclab.cloner.replicate` to consume those dispatch settings only from its ``ClonePlan``.

Removed
^^^^^^^

* Removed the top-level ``InteractiveSceneCfg.filter_collisions`` and
  ``InteractiveSceneCfg.replicate_physics`` fields. Configure
  ``InteractiveSceneCfg.clone_cfg`` with ``CloneCfg.isolate_environments`` and
  ``CloneCfg.replicate_physics`` instead.
* Removed :meth:`isaaclab.scene.InteractiveScene.filter_collisions` and
  :func:`isaaclab.cloner.filter_collisions`; environment isolation is now applied
  automatically from ``CloneCfg`` at the physics-manager assembly barrier.
* Removed ``AssetBaseCfg.collision_group`` and ``TerrainImporterCfg.collision_group``.
  Shared colliders are inferred from prim paths outside ``CloneCfg.clone_template``.
  Remove explicit ``collision_group=-1`` and ``collision_group=0`` arguments. For
  an environment-scoped collider that previously used ``-1``, move it outside the
  clone template or use the broader ``CloneCfg(isolate_environments=False)`` opt-out.
